resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR page for this tower prints US 1188, CA 119 and that number is kept. A firelookout.org list gives a different number (US 1420, CA 225) for a Mariposa/Tuolumne Smith Peak; the NHLR page is treated as the register of record.

notes_for_editor: Two Smith Peak lookouts exist: this Tuolumne tower (Stanislaus NF) and a separate Plumas County tower near Lake Davis. The brief's source page smith-peak.html is the Tuolumne page and is correct for this record. The Plumas story (us-ca-smith-peak-plumas-national-forest) states that the Tuolumne tower burned in 1987; this record confirms that from NHLR, the Forest Lookouts page, and the 1988 Merced Sun-Star item it quotes. Staffing evidence is dated 2012 (PDF) and undated (NHLR, present tense); the 2024 visitor report describes the access road only and does not confirm staffing or visiting rules, so current access is unverified. The Roaming Civic page was read only for the access-road passage. Photos on NHLR are credited but no licence was seen, so none added. The 2012 report is the only source for the catwalk and roof work.
